items.label: FIGURE B3.1.1
items.title: Counting people at high risk from climate-related hazards
items.content: The diagram illustrates the criteria for determining if a person is at risk from climate hazards. The logic is: (Exposed to climate hazards) AND (Vulnerable to experiencing losses). 'Exposed to climate hazards' is defined as experiencing 'Any 1' of: Flood, Drought, Extreme heat, or Cyclone. 'Vulnerable to experiencing losses' is defined as being either 'Physically vulnerable' OR 'Unable to cope'. 'Unable to cope' is defined as experiencing 'Any 1' of: No access to water, No access to electricity, Low access to services and markets, Low income, No access to social protection, No access to financial instrument, or Low education level. Source: World Bank Group Scorecard indicator, https://scorecard.worldbank.org/en/scorecard/home.
